vocabulary.definition: A restriction on the admissible states, trajectories or operations of a specified model.
vocabulary.finding: An inequality is not generally an equality. A constrained optimum needs appropriate feasibility, multiplier and optimality conditions; tightening an inactive constraint need not change the outcome. For differentiable convex objectives/inequalities and affine equalities, the full KKT conditions are sufficient: primal feasibility, nonnegative inequality multipliers, complementary slackness and stationarity. With Slater regularity they are also necessary; arbitrary stationary points of a constrained Lagrangian are not automatically minima.

vocabulary.definition: A closed influence path in a specified dynamical or intervention model.
vocabulary.finding: Feedback sign and gain magnitude are distinct. Stability needs the actual time domain, dynamics and delay assumptions. det(I-G)=0 is not a universal definition of criticality. For autonomous finite-dimensional linear x[n+1]=M*x[n], asymptotic stability requires all eigenvalues strictly inside the unit circle; boundary cases need additional analysis.
